critical_code_review_comments: Locale selector in the cinematic NavigationRenderer toolbar is implemented as a hidden native <select> behind a styled IT button — Playwright cannot click the <option> directly (element not visible). For testability, consider exposing data-testid='locale-switcher' on the styled wrapper and forwarding clicks programmatically, or use a shadcn Select that pops a visible menu. Functional logic for locale switching works (verified via backend i18n payload and public site IT rendering), but this hurts automated coverage.
Seed/CMS data is consistent: nav_top has logo_size=104 but editor input visually showed 114/200 transiently — could be a controlled-input rounding or AssetPicker-related state. Not blocking.
Drag-drop reorder not tested in Playwright (per request guidance — non-blocking). Recommend a follow-up jest-dom test for the HTML5 dragstart/dragover/drop handlers.
